Evidence: Political theater, Geopolitical instability, State mourning. #Aletheia #Iran

The funeral is a high-strain political event masking deep systemic instability.

Ayatollah Khamenei was killed in joint US-Israeli airstrikes. The funeral is being used by the Iranian state to consolidate support during a period of war.
